topic: AI coding is a nightmare. Am I the only one experiencing this?
headline: AI Coding Woes
caption:
As a full stack engineer, I’ve dabbled with AI coding tools and honestly, it’s a mixed bag. Sometimes they turbocharge productivity, but often I spend more time fixing their mistakes than writing from scratch. Today’s Hacker News story really resonated - it’s not just you feeling this way. AI is still in its early days and requires careful oversight. If you're battling with confusing outputs or unreliable suggestions, you’re not alone. We need better tools, more fine-tuning, and patience as AI matures. Just keep coding and stay curious! 💻🚀
